blocks.text: Chlorine dono metals se react kar ke hal-pazeer namak deti hai. Yeh sodium se hararat kharij karte hue (exothermically) react karti hai, sunehri peela shola nazar aata hai aur safed thos sodium chloride banta hai: 2Na(s) + Cl2(g) se 2NaCl(s). Magnesium bhi chlorine se react kar ke safed thos magnesium chloride deta hai: Mg(s) + Cl2(g) se MgCl2(s).

blocks.prompt: Sodium aur magnesium ke oxides aur hydroxides ki noiyat kya hai, aur calcium, ek group 2 unsur, ke liye pani aur oxygen se aap kya peshgoi karenge?
blocks.explanation: Dono ke oxides aur hydroxides basic hain. Calcium, group 2 mein magnesium ke neeche, zyada dhaati aur reactive hai, to yeh thande pani se magnesium se zyada asani se react kar ke calcium hydroxide aur hydrogen deta hai, aur oxygen mein jal kar basic oxide calcium oxide deta hai.

items: Chlorine dono metals se safed hal-pazeer chlorides deti hai: 2Na + Cl2 se 2NaCl (sunehri shola, exothermic); Mg + Cl2 se MgCl2.
